assertions.name: sdp_cos_factor_singular_at_u_substrate
assertions.source: The literal SDP normalization Q_A·cos α_eff = Q_N2/(1-u²) has no zero/pole at u_substrate (smooth, nonzero; N2 pole at u=±1 is ~117× farther). The pole is intrinsic to the c_k Habiro ladder, not the cos-factor. Expected False (synthesis refuted in literal form).

description: Task-2 (kernel deepening): tests whether the residue-A pole at u_substrate is a zero of the SDP normalization Q_A·cos α_eff = Q_N2/(1-u²). Result: REFUTED in literal form — Q_A·cos(u_substrate) = 0.782391 ≠ 0, and its only singularity (N2=0 at u=±1) is ~116.4× farther than u_substrate. So the pole is INTRINSIC to the c_k Habiro ladder (radius = u_substrate, PR #1713), not the cos-correction factor. Refines the #1823 SDP-shadow-price synthesis (flagged not-yet-derived): the literal cos-factor reading is out; the keystone is Q_N2's deeper Habiro structure / c_11+. Diagnostic-only.
